correctness.rationale: Translation/reflection averaging exhausts all competing operators without increasing norm. L1 coercivity gives a minimizer; differentiability and sine moment stationarity force exactly three simple crossing roots of the associated cubic. Conversely the five-equation system has zero gradient and is globally optimal by convexity. Equal-norm midpoint equality and three common simple crossings force proportional cubics and then identical Fourier-normalized kernels. Elementary antiderivative supplies the exact value. Finite mpmath checks are only supplementary.
